CodeRabbit.pro: $12/seat/month (billed annually) or $15/seat/month (monthly), unlimited reviews, private repos, priority support

tiers.Free: Limited to 1 repo, 50 reviews/month, no custom rules

GitHub Copilot.PR_review_pricing: Included in Copilot Enterprise at $39/user/month (billed annually), or $45/user/month (monthly); standalone PR review not sold separately

Qodana.pricing: Free for open-source and 1 private project; Cloud Pro at $25/seat/month (billed annually) or $30/seat/month (monthly), includes unlimited projects and reviews

SonarQube Cloud.pricing: Free for public repos; Team plan at $15/seat/month (billed annually) or $18/seat/month (monthly), includes private repos, up to 100k lines of code; Enterprise at $150/seat/month

sweet_spot_price.rationale: Solo devs are price-sensitive; $9/month undercuts CodeRabbit Pro ($12) and Sourcery Pro ($10) while still providing positive margin with DeepSeek backend (~$0.15/1M tokens).

pricing_model.reasoning: Per-repo is too restrictive for solo devs with multiple projects; per-seat irrelevant for single user; per-review creates friction and reduces usage. Flat monthly maximizes simplicity and adoption, leading to higher lifetime value.

revenue_maximization.strategy: Offer a free tier (1 repo, 50 reviews/month) to acquire users, then convert to $9/month flat for unlimited repos and reviews. With DeepSeek backend cost ~$0.15/1M tokens and average solo dev generating 200 reviews/month (~2M tokens), cost per user is ~$0.30, yielding ~$8.70 gross profit per user. Target 500 users in first year for $52,200 annual revenue.
